summary: A phone-first catalog site for a fictional independent clothing boutique in Houston Heights, with new arrivals first, real prices and sizes, a size guide and buy buttons that link to the owner's own checkout.
highlights: New arrivals lead the page, each with price, sizes left and colors as real text
Buy buttons are ready to link to the owner's own Shopify, Square or Stripe checkout
A size guide table plus shipping, returns and exchanges in plain words
Hours, a neighborhood map, Directions and one-tap call for shoppers on the way over
